entities.name: Svetozar Gligorić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Svetozar Gligorić was a Serbian chess grandmaster and musician. He won the championship of Yugoslavia a record 11 times, and is considered the best player ever from Serbia and Yugoslavia. In 1958, he received the Golden Badge award for the best athlete of Yugoslavia.
